issues.message: Correct answer is the longest option in 10/15 questions (66.7%), against ~25% by chance. A student can score above chance by always picking the wordiest option, without knowing the material.
issues.fix: Rebalance option lengths, per assessment-testing-standard.md section 1: pad distractors with equally specific but WRONG justifications, and trim the verbose correct answer. Do not just shorten the correct option until it is shortest — that inverts the tell. Target is near chance (~25%), not zero. Measure with: node _tools/eduscan/answer-balance-audit.js

issues.message: Correct answer is the longest option in 6/12 questions (50%), against ~25% by chance. A student can score above chance by always picking the wordiest option, without knowing the material.
issues.fix: Rebalance option lengths, per assessment-testing-standard.md section 1: pad distractors with equally specific but WRONG justifications, and trim the verbose correct answer. Do not just shorten the correct option until it is shortest — that inverts the tell. Target is near chance (~25%), not zero. Measure with: node _tools/eduscan/answer-balance-audit.js

issues.message: Correct answer is the longest option in 9/10 questions (90%), against ~25% by chance. A student can score above chance by always picking the wordiest option, without knowing the material.
issues.fix: Rebalance option lengths, per assessment-testing-standard.md section 1: pad distractors with equally specific but WRONG justifications, and trim the verbose correct answer. Do not just shorten the correct option until it is shortest — that inverts the tell. Target is near chance (~25%), not zero. Measure with: node _tools/eduscan/answer-balance-audit.js

issues.message: Correct answer is the longest option in 6/10 questions (60%), against ~25% by chance. A student can score above chance by always picking the wordiest option, without knowing the material.
issues.fix: Rebalance option lengths, per assessment-testing-standard.md section 1: pad distractors with equally specific but WRONG justifications, and trim the verbose correct answer. Do not just shorten the correct option until it is shortest — that inverts the tell. Target is near chance (~25%), not zero. Measure with: node _tools/eduscan/answer-balance-audit.js

issues.message: Correct answer is the longest option in 9/15 questions (60%), against ~25% by chance. A student can score above chance by always picking the wordiest option, without knowing the material.
issues.fix: Rebalance option lengths, per assessment-testing-standard.md section 1: pad distractors with equally specific but WRONG justifications, and trim the verbose correct answer. Do not just shorten the correct option until it is shortest — that inverts the tell. Target is near chance (~25%), not zero. Measure with: node _tools/eduscan/answer-balance-audit.js

issues.message:
Shared progress key — 2 files all call ModuleProgress.complete('script', 'script-clh-003-intro', ...). ModuleProgress.isFirstCompletion uses bare moduleId, so only the first file's completion pushes XP/badges to Firestore; subsequent completions across these 2 files are silently suppressed. Files:
  - houses/script/clh/script-clh-003-intro.applet.html
  - houses/script/courses/clh/modules/clh-003/script-intro.module.html
issues.fix: Use module-scoped keys per file. Pattern: 'script-COURSE-PARENT-MODULE' where each parent module has a unique slug. E.g., 'cloud-wsa-m04-guilab' instead of shared 'cloud-guilab'.
